verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions ClickUp's board/list/calendar/timeline (Gantt) views or the ability to switch between them; feature list items are generic (Docs, Chat, Automations, Sprints, Whiteboards) and community comments focus on folder/status configuration and general software quality complaints, not view-switching. Missing for 10: any doc or community reference to multiple view types (board, list, calendar, timeline/Gantt) or evidence of switching between them.
